title: fix(metadata-protocol): a .custom pair's published override of a dashboard, report or email template no longer wears the base's envelope in the registry's bare slot
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi92Y3Af8UHfhCRCgvN9XxUC5)_

Fixes #29600
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`.custom` 配对包对基础包仪表盘、报表、邮件模板的已发布覆盖，不再以基础包的信封注册进注册表的裸槽位（沿用 #22057 对 view 的规则，扩到这三种类型）。
- 为什么改：基础包的按包层（导出读取它）会把覆盖项和基础包自己的项并列列出，注册表直读也会把覆盖项当成基础包的项。
- 风险与回滚：所有协议服务读取（按名读、有效列表、分层读）前后逐项测量不变；只有注册表直读不再看到覆盖。回滚即还原本 PR，无需迁移。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-bindings.ts` 中的 `declinesBorrowedEnvelope`，以及新测试 `protocol-custom-override-bare-slot-envelope.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/protocol-custom-override-bare-slot-envelope.test.ts src/environment-overlay-email-locale-restart.test.ts`
- 需要你做的：无,席位落地

## What changes

A published override of a base's dashboard, report or email template, saved in the base's `.custom` pair, was registered in the registry's bare slot wearing the BASE's artifact envelope (`_packageId` = BASE, `_provenance: 'package'`). The base's per-package layer, which the base's export reads, then listed the override beside the base's own item, and every registry-direct read of the base's item answered the override.

The hydrator (`hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry`) now declines the bare slot for a row of these three types when the row's bound package ships no artifact of the name while another package does. This is the #22057 view rule, widened per seat ruling A to dashboard, report and email_template. The rule lives in `declinesBorrowedEnvelope` in `protocol-package-bindings.ts`, a closed list of three types.

- View is unchanged (it keeps its own #22057 limb).
- The #4624 case keeps its bare entry: a row of a package that ships its own artifact of the name.
- page, app, dataset, doc and book are left out on purpose. For them the bare slot IS the served override (getMetaItem, getMetaItems, GET /me/apps), so they need a row-served path first. That is follow-up **#29613**, which also carries the two class-b findings from the measurement.
- flow is left out: no envelope (Regime C), and the boot pull arms its declared override from the bare slot.
- The delete-heal limb has no twin of the rule, because it registers the baseline's own body and grafts no artifact envelope (docblock note only, no code change).

Files (5, +424 / −17):

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-bindings.ts`: `declinesBorrowedEnvelope` and its type list.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`: one guard line in the hydrator, plus the header and heal docblocks.
- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-custom-override-bare-slot-envelope.test.ts` (NEW): the per-type pins. It sits in objectql because the pins need the real ObjectQL engine, the in-memory driver and the real registry, and a metadata-protocol test cannot import objectql (that would be a dependency cycle). It reads metadata-protocol from `dist/`, like the sibling `protocol-per-package-layer-provenance.test.ts` whose harness it copies. No objectql source is edited.
- `packages/objectql/src/environment-overlay-email-locale-restart.test.ts`: forced edits, listed below.
- `.changeset/29600-pair-override-bare-slot-envelope.md`: patch for `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`.

## Tests

New file `packages/objectql/src/protocol-custom-override-bare-slot-envelope.test.ts`, 9 tests. Per type (view, dashboard, report, email_template) two tests:

- (a) The base's per-package layer lists the base's item alone, and the pair's lists the override alone. The bare slot holds no entry for the name (`name@en-US` for the email template). `registry.getItem` answers the base's own item.
- (b) The served reads still serve the override: getMetaItem with no package, BASE and PAIR; getMetaItems with no package and BASE; getMetaItemLayered(BASE).effective.

A control pins #4624: OTHER also ships the dashboard and owns a stored row, so its bare entry stays with OTHER's envelope and `_provenance: 'package'`.

Forced edits in `packages/objectql/src/environment-overlay-email-locale-restart.test.ts` (seat-approved, on condition that no non-test email_template registry reader moves; the audit is under Acceptance notes). These four cases pinned the registry entry of a pair's override of a SHIPPED member, which is exactly the entry this PR removes. Each now pins the served read, and keeps the registry pin on the shipped body:

1. "DELETE by member: resetting zh-CN removes its row only, and the en-US overlay stays served — the registry included": the registry pins become `PKG en` / `PKG zh`. The served reads go through the protocol (`subjectOf(protocol, 'en-US')`), and after the restart `subjectOf(after.protocol, 'en-US')` = `ADMIN en`.
2. "DELETE by member of a member NO artifact ships: its overlay leaves the registry, and the canonical overlay stays": adds the by-name read `getMetaItem({ type, name, member: 'en-US' })` = `ADMIN digest en`; the registry entry for en-US is `PKG digest en`.
3. "DELETE with no member": the registry pin on zh-CN `ADMIN zh` is replaced by `subjectOf(protocol, 'zh-CN')` = `ADMIN zh`.
4. "the cluster fan-out: a peer converges on the member a write changed, and a member reset heals only that member": the peer converges through `vi.waitFor` on `subjectOf(peer.protocol, 'zh-CN')` = `ADMIN zh`; the registry pins are `PKG zh` / `PKG en` and stay `PKG zh` on both nodes after the delete.

Ablation of the guard back to view-only. The anchor line in `declinesBorrowedEnvelope` is replaced so that it returns false for every type. The marker is confirmed in `dist/`, and the restore is proved by an empty `git diff HEAD` and `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` exit 0.

- New pin file alone: 3 red (dashboard, report, email_template per-package tests), 6 green.
- New pin file plus the email-locale file: 6 red (those 3 plus forced-edit cases 1, 2 and 4), 44 green.
- The (b) served-read tests stay green under the ablation by design: those reads never came from the bare slot. The view pin stays green because the #22057 limb guards view on its own.
- A first ablation attempt failed the build and ran no tests. It was restored and is not counted.

## Acceptance notes

Bar from the ruling: no protocol read moves. Every reader was measured before (main 0ab4a09e) and after (this branch) with the same harness: real ObjectQL, the in-memory driver and the protocol from `dist/`. The base is registered by `registerApp`, the pair installed by `installPackage`, and the override is a draft save into the pair declaring the override, then the publish. S is the shipped body, O the override; the envelope is label / `_packageId` / `_provenance`.

| Reader | view | dashboard / report / email_template | page / app / dataset / doc / book |
|---|---|---|---|
| bare slot entry | none → none | O/BASE/package → **none** | O/BASE → O/BASE |
| registry.getItem (bare, BASE, PAIR) | unchanged | O → **S** | unchanged |
| registry.listItems(BASE) | unchanged | [S, O] → **[S]** | unchanged |
| per-package layer, BASE | [S] → [S] | [S, O] → **[S]** | [S, O] → [S, O] |
| per-package layer, PAIR | [O] → [O] | [O] → [O] | [] → [] |
| per-package layer, unscoped | unchanged | [O, O] → **[S, O]** | unchanged |
| getMetaItem (none, BASE, PAIR) | O → O | O → O | O → O |
| getMetaItems (none, BASE) | [O] → [O] | [O] → [O] | [O] → [O] |
| getMetaItemLayered(BASE).effective | O → O | O → O | S → S |
| GET /me/apps | n/a | n/a | O → O (app) |

Only the bold cells move, and none of them is a protocol served read. translation was not measurable through the pair (the save is refused NOT_OVERRIDABLE in this harness). flow and action are outside the card.

email_template non-test registry readers, per the condition on the forced edits:

| Reader | Reads | Moves? |
|---|---|---|
| plugin-email `template-loader.ts` | the protocol first (by-name read with member); the registry only when no protocol is wired | no: the protocol read serves O before and after |
| cli `organization-ownership.ts` TemplatePort | stored rows plus `getMetaItemsForExecution` | no: neither reads the bare slot |
| objectql registry direct (`getItem`, `listItems`) | the registry | yes, O → S (the intended change, bold above) |
| protocol by-name / list / layered | stored rows via `findServedOverlayRow` and the list merge | no |

The plugin-email suite (48 files) and the cli ownership tests pass on the fixed head, as listed under Verification.

Follow-up: **#29613** holds page, app, dataset, doc and book (row-served override path first, then the guard), and the two class-b findings: the pair's per-package layer is empty for those types, and their layered effective serves S while getMetaItem serves O.

## Verification
